stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.description: No actions, reactions or voluntary movement. Automatically fail STR/AGI saves; attacks against you have advantage.
stunned.manualLabel: Saves: GM records automatic STR/AGI failure. Advantage: GM applies the table's Prism procedure and enters the final result. Forced movement/teleportation: GM adjudicates and repositions. Expiry: GM removes each exact source instance.

timings.critical-one-round: One round (bludgeoning critical) — GM tracks the round and removes.
timings.shield-bash-target-end: Until end of target's next turn (Shield Bash) — GM removes.
timings.authored-target-next-start: Until the start of the target's next turn — expires at the authenticated turn boundary.
timings.authored-target-next-end: Until the end of the target's next turn — expires at the authenticated turn boundary.
timings.authored-target-start-count: Until the start of a counted upcoming turn of the target — expires at the authenticated turn boundary.
timings.authored-target-end-count: Until the end of a counted upcoming turn of the target — expires at the authenticated turn boundary.

movementModifier.description: Flat change to movement speed: the distance each movement AP buys. Applied after other speed conditions; the result never goes below 0 ft. Stunned still allows no voluntary movement.
movementModifier.combinationPolicy: Different named effects add together. Reapplying the same effect from the same exact source refreshes its duration instead of stacking its value. The result never goes below 0 ft.

defending.name: Defending
defending.description: Until your next turn, your blocking piece's DR rolls count double and never wear it. No Armor/AC or flat-DR bonus.
defending.expiryLabel: Until your next turn — GM removes.
